description: A full calendar client in Svelte 5 built on the Scheduler and SvDockManager. A NavPane module rail switches between Calendar, Mail, People and Tasks; the Calendar module is a dockable workspace with the scheduler in Month, Week, Day or Agenda driven by a mini date picker, an Upcoming grid and an Inbox auto-hidden to the bottom edge, and the arrangement persists across reloads. Meeting cards show attendee avatars, recurring events take per-occurrence edits through recurrenceField and recurrenceExceptionsField, a second time-zone ruler runs beside the day, and .ics import and export plus undo complete it.

faq.question: How are recurring events edited per occurrence?
faq.answer: The row holds a rule in recurrenceField and a list of exceptions in recurrenceExceptionsField; editing one occurrence writes an exception for that date while the series stays intact.

faq.question: How does iCal import work?
faq.answer: The demo parses an .ics file into rows with start, end, title and recurrence and appends them; export walks the rows back into VEVENT entries and downloads the file.

faq.question: How is the workspace persisted?
faq.answer: The SvDockManager state, tiled panes, the auto-hidden Upcoming and Inbox and any floated window, is serialized to localStorage and restored on load.
